name: Heatblast
bodyType: Magma-rock humanoid (plasma body under volcanic rock plates)
abilities: Pyrokinesis (fire streams, fireballs, fire bombs, fire lasers)
weaknesses: Fire is useless against fireproof or heat-empowered foes (Crabdozer, Tetramands, Petrosapiens, Vaxasaurians)
Flames can be extinguished by water, wind or fire-suppressants (usually reignites quickly)
Burns whatever he touches; can accidentally spread fires
Cannot survive the vacuum of space
A cold virus inverts his powers to cryokinesis (Side Effects)
summary: Ben's very first transformation: a seven-foot Pyronite whose plasma body radiates and hurls fire, and who later learns to fly on flame and rock.
traits: Only Ben alien with eyes that were never green
notableFeats: Melted Vilgax's Mechadroids and buried Vilgax in asphalt (Secrets)
Destroyed the Nosedeenians' planetarium with a fire bomb (Tourist Trap)
Vaporized S.A.M.'s water form by circling on a fire-board (Monster Weather)
As a 4-year-old, flash-vaporized the Fountain of Youth (Don't Drink the Water)
Defeated King Viktor (Viktor: The Spoils) and Ultimate Vilgax alongside Sir George (The Ultimate Enemy: Part 1)
Melted free of Sentient Ultimate Big Chill's ice (The Ultimate Sacrifice)

appearances.designNotes: Dark reddish-brown volcanic rock over an orange plasma body; two-toed feet; original Omnitrix on chest; fiery aura connected to the eyes. Ben 10,000's version adds two shoulder volcanoes; 4-year-old 'Heatbrat' is tiny with an oversized head. Race Against Time (alt timeline) live-action version has more exposed plasma with yellow-glow cracks.

16-year-old design resembles Alan Albright: burnt-black charcoal rocks with red edge markings, lighter yellow plasma, eyes no longer connected to the head fire, Ultimatrix on chest. 10-year-old Heatblast (Forge of Creation) mixes the UA build with OS colours and a green Omnitrix.

UA-style rocks but eyes reconnected to the head fire, taller and more muscular, tilted shoulder plates, redesigned feet. 16/11/10-year-old versions share the design; only the Omnitrix ring colour differs (white for 16, silver for 11).

scoring.rationale: Strong ranged pyrokinetic: melts tanks and warship hulls, planetarium-levelling fire bombs, and later true flight via fire/rock propulsion. Not top-tier physically and useless against fireproof foes (Crabdozer, Diamondhead) and easily doused; collateral fire risk costs a control point.

notes: Not used in Alien Force: locked by the Omnitrix recalibration; only a hologram appears (Vengeance of Vilgax: Part 1, Busy Box).
Race Against Time appearance is the alternate 'Race Against Time' timeline (live-action design).
Also used by Kevin (Framed), Gwen (Gwen 10, non-canon) and Sandra (Destroy All Aliens) - not counted as Ben appearances.
Heroes United (Generator Rex crossover) cameo only in a non-diegetic flashback; UA appearance stands on the UA episodes.
